summary:
Space robots travel millions of kilometres to the Moon and Mars. They take photos, study rocks, and uncover amazing mysteries. But they cannot fly home or be fixed — when their energy runs out, they fall silent and stay in space. People may see them as abandoned machines, but we call them Ghost Explorers.
 
This project shares the touching stories of three brave explorers: Viking 1, Spirit, and Opportunity. Viking 1 was the first to land safely on Mars, working for 6 years. Spirit explored for years until it got stuck in soft sand but kept sending data. Opportunity worked for nearly 15 years, finding evidence of ancient water, before falling silent in a storm.
 
Every discovery they made helped human space exploration grow. They are silent, but they are never forgotten. Their stories continue to inspire us all.
details: Ghost Explorers is an educational storybook that honors the legacy of robotic missions on Mars, including Spirit, Opportunity, and Viking 1. Through beautiful illustrations and heartfelt storytelling, we bring these spacecraft to life as silent explorers who faithfully served humanity — showing that being overlooked does not mean being forgotten. Our project makes space history personal and approachable, inspiring curiosity and appreciation for every mission that contributed to our journey of discovery. We used AI image generation and digital design tools to create a warm, dreamy visual style while ensuring factual accuracy and respect for each mission's real history. The AI tools that we use include DOLA AI,CHAT GPT,GOOGLE VIDS,DOUBAO,CANVA,GOOGLE.What makes our project unique is its emotional focus: we celebrate perseverance, quiet duty, and the idea that every contribution matters — even when the mission is done. Our goal is to leave audiences with a simple but powerful message: explorers may be left behind, but they are never truly gone as long as their stories are remembered.Project showcase:
